Tamil Nadu CM Vijay Holds Meetings on Alliances and Governance

Tamil Nadu Chief Minister C Joseph Vijay is holding consultative meetings with post-poll alliance partners and addressing administrative matters. Discussions involve forming a new secular alliance and focusing on issues like women's safety, crime, and the film industry. The opposition DMK has also raised concerns about alleged interference in cabinet meetings.
